Cozy Coco Catcher

Support This Game

🥥🌴🥥🌴🥥

Cozy Coco Catcher is a comfy incremental game in which you need to collect and resell coconuts in order to upgrade your skills. Upgrade everything to buy the ticket back to home.

Made in two weeks for Comfy Jam: Summer 2026 (theme: Coconuts, Waves, & Beaches)

🥥🌴🥥🌴🥥

Art & code: FeatureKreep

Music: Reggae Island Vibes by Alex Morgan & Caribbean Beach by Anastasia Chubarova

Color palette used: Beach Day Palette by wobdor

CHEATS: Press P to get 10,000 of each resource

Cleotroph7 days ago(+1)

The look and feel here is really good, but I feel the fundamental gameplay loop is lacking. Strength upgrades don't do anything past the first two levels (since you never hit enough to complete an action in one cycle), the clock doesn't actually impact the gameplay at all, and you end up just having to sit and wait for about 5 minutes with no real progression to finish the game. (also why is this tagged as a platformer?)

I think there's a great game in here, it just needs a little more thought put into the actual gameplay.

I would recommend:
- making strength have more impact but also be the most expensive upgrade as it is the fundamental time gate for the rest of the game

- Fixing the extra drop chance formula so more than the first 3 upgrades matter for bonus drops. This could potentially be extended to include a chance of a 3rd or 4th drop

- Add scaling to the levels so it feels like there's a reason to buy the xp upgrades

How did you create such a polished skill tree in C3? I can never find a tutorial or anything I can use as a reference.

Reply
FeatureKreep11 days ago(+3)

I published the source files on my Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/collection/2053809?view=expanded

The basic gist is, each node except the first one has a parent node (right click -> Hierarchy -> add selection). When a parent node is clicked on, all its children nodes get unlocked and can now be interacted with.

Nodes have special parameters: Name + Description, Level, Upgrade Stat + Upgrade Number, Cost + Currency Type.
